services.desc: Our largest space is the Grand L&N Lobby. With stunning, arched windows and hand laid Italian tile this is the perfect space for larger affairs. For a sit-down dinner, the capacity of this room is 100. For a Sweet Sixteen or formal dance, it can hold 150. Our meeting room, located adjacent to the Lobby, in the L&N Depot building, is perfect for business meetings, trainings, and bridal or baby showers! This room offers a built-in beverage bar and the same beautiful, hand laid tile as the Grand Lobby!
